name: m4-branch-integ-pekko
description: Per first-parent commit of the rebuilt integration branch (2.13.x `278cab1040` .. `f0b6e17bd9`): which merged PR moves a compile of pekko-actor and pekko-stream 1.7.1, a corpus outside the compiler. Commits before the default change use the `chars` name table, later ones `shared`.

On the M4, 1 round, xctrace ipc; compiler built with release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); the corpus is compiled plainly, without pekko's own `-opt`. Patched JDK 26, `jdkHome=25.0.4-tem`, 8G heap, single-shot 8 warmup and 10 measured, warmup from the plateau in `m4-integ-pekko-2`. The test-only and PERF-INTEGRATION.md commits change no compiler code, so they are A/A controls for their neighbours.
